title: Homemade Mayonnaise
description: A simple and delicious homemade mayonnaise recipe that is quick to prepare.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until the mixture emulsifies into mayonnaise.
notes:
Ensure all ingredients are at room temperature for the best emulsion.
